description: Repairs r-sql-13b/agg-stat-argument-types: aliases b, c and d collided with columns. Asks what Var, VarP, StDev and StDevP give, with which Field type, over two rows (a Byte, Integer, Long, Single, Currency, Double and Date column of table SI, rows 1 and 2) with aliases va, vpp, sdv and sdp that cannot collide with a column, each column in its own statement. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-expr is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.

args.text: CREATE TABLE SI (id LONG CONSTRAINT PK_SI PRIMARY KEY, i SHORT, b BYTE, l LONG, s SINGLE, c CURRENCY, d DOUBLE, dt DATETIME)
SELECT * FROM SI ORDER BY id
SELECT Var(i) AS va, VarP(i) AS vpp, StDev(i) AS sdv, StDevP(i) AS sdp FROM SI
SELECT Var(b) AS va, VarP(b) AS vpp, StDev(b) AS sdv, StDevP(b) AS sdp FROM SI
SELECT Var(l) AS va, VarP(l) AS vpp, StDev(l) AS sdv, StDevP(l) AS sdp FROM SI
SELECT Var(s) AS va, VarP(s) AS vpp, StDev(s) AS sdv, StDevP(s) AS sdp FROM SI
SELECT Var(c) AS va, VarP(c) AS vpp, StDev(c) AS sdv, StDevP(c) AS sdp FROM SI
SELECT Var(d) AS va, VarP(d) AS vpp, StDev(d) AS sdv, StDevP(d) AS sdp FROM SI
SELECT Var(dt) AS va, VarP(dt) AS vpp, StDev(dt) AS sdv, StDevP(dt) AS sdp FROM SI
